# Skill: check-bruno-hurl-sync

**When to use:** Regenerate or verify the Bruno collection stays synchronized with Hurl sources before commit or in CI.

## Scope
- `realworld/specs/api/hurl-to-bruno.js`
- `realworld/specs/api/bruno`
- `realworld/specs/api/hurl`
- `realworld/Makefile`

## Prerequisites
- Bun runtime to execute hurl-to-bruno.js

## Steps
1. From realworld/, run make bruno-check (invoked by realworld/.github/workflows/bruno-check.yml on push and pull_request).
2. To regenerate locally, run bun realworld/specs/api/hurl-to-bruno.js without --check.
3. To verify only, run bun realworld/specs/api/hurl-to-bruno.js --check; mismatches exit with code 1.

## Existing example
- `hurl-to-bruno.js parses Hurl into .bru files; check mode compares temp output to committed api/bruno.`
